the best algorithm to use is the one that minimizes the number of messages sent during rekeying.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
stateless rekey algorithms are not necessarily better than stateful algorithms.

stateless rekey algorithms are more appropriate for group applications with large membership changes, and stateful rekey algorithms are better for small membership changes.

stateful algorithms are not always better than stateless algorithms in all cases.
stateful rekeying algorithms perform better when membership changes are processed in batches, while stateless rekey is more appropriate in applications with frequent membership changes.
